summary: Frontend-only Expo web preview tested at 390x844 mobile viewport. All critical flows (login, home totals, date nav, pumps, fuel numpad+entries, history sheet, buses CRUD, logout, local persistence across reload) passed. Minor non-blocking RN deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted at runtime (likely from a dependency / internal component).

react_native_issues.issue: Runtime console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Likely in an internal UI component (Sheet/overlay) or dependency. Search codebase for pointerEvents="..." prop and move to style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}.

action_items: Migrate any `pointerEvents` JSX prop usages to `style.pointerEvents` to silence RN deprecation warning (non-blocking).

On web, native Share is not available; Excel export relies on XLSX.writeFile download and PDF uses print dialog — this was observed to not throw and is correct for web preview. Validate real file download UX on a device build.
critical_code_review_comments: store.tsx: `updateShift` persists every keystroke via storage.setItem — fine for AsyncStorage but could churn I/O on web; consider debouncing for pump inputs.
fuel.tsx: entry.qty strips trailing comma but does not validate numeric format beyond num(qty)>0; acceptable given numpad input.
buses.tsx: `canAdd` requires length>=3, matches intent; search filter uses `includes` (substring) which is fine.
login.tsx: ADMIN_PASSWORD hardcoded ('puzopb') per user requirement — acceptable for offline personal app, but note it is in source.
No test for Excel/PDF export triggered via browser download because exports use XLSX.writeFile/print; not easily asserted in Playwright. Reported as untested, not failing.
seed_data_creation: Created runtime shift data (today's date) via UI: pumps 1&2 (50 + 75 = 125 L diff), fuel entries 7000 (50.5 L, card НЕ) and 7013 (25 L, card ДА). Added+removed test bus 9999. Data persisted via local storage across logout and full reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is pure offline; no backend. Admin password 'puzopb'. Default bus list in /app/frontend/src/data/buses.ts (276 entries, 7000 present, 1234 not). Expo web served at http://localhost:3000. Mobile viewport 390x844. All testIDs documented in review_request worked as expected including tab-home/tab-pumps/tab-fuel/tab-history, numpad-0..9/comma/del, fuel-card-yes/no, fuel-entry-<bus>, bus-remove-<n>, history-item-YYYY-MM-DD. Native share and real file-download not asserted (web preview limitation).
